"""Exclusive existing-session B8 MTP correctness and memory trial; no timing admission."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,sys,time,zipfile
ROOT=Path('D:/CantorAI/5090-study-20261023');M=ROOT/'Garnet/test2026/cuda/qwen38_5090';JOB='paged-batch8-mtp-admission-attempt1'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    assert Path(__file__).resolve().parent==M.resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(M))
    from run_logged import run
    from run_bf16_low_batch_native_build import idle
    from run_bf16_batch8_admission import retire
    prep=M/'evidence/paged-batch8-mtp-preparation.json';p=json.loads(prep.read_bytes())
    for n,h in p['files'].items():assert sha(ROOT/n)==h,('Paged B8 MTP source drift',n)
    for n,h in p['runtime'].items():assert sha(ROOT/'build/bin'/n)==h
    for n,h in p['environment'].items():assert sha(Path(n))==h
    for name,row in p['parents'].items():
        proof=ROOT/'results'/(name+'-verified.json');q=json.loads(proof.read_bytes());assert sha(proof)==row['proof_sha256'] and q['status']==row['status'] and sha(ROOT/'results'/(name+'-evidence.zip'))==q['archive_sha256']==row['archive_sha256']
        w=json.loads((ROOT/'results'/name/'workflow.json').read_bytes());assert w['exit_code']==0 and w['cleanup_finished'] and w['source_sha256']==w['source_after_sha256'] and w['runtime_dependencies']==w['runtime_dependencies_after']
    receipt=ROOT/'results/study-ssd-engine-cache/receipt.json';cache=Path(json.loads(receipt.read_bytes())['cache_root'])
    assert cache.resolve().drive.upper()=='C:' and json.loads((cache/'study-owner.json').read_bytes())['study']==str(ROOT) and shutil.disk_usage(cache).free>=96*1024**3
    out=ROOT/'results'/JOB;archive=ROOT/'results'/(JOB+'-evidence.zip');assert not out.exists() and not archive.exists()
    idle();out.mkdir();os.chdir(ROOT/'Garnet');before={f.name for f in cache.iterdir()};started=time.time();code=1
    w={'status':'running','source_sha256':p['files'],'runtime_dependencies':p['runtime'],'environment_before':p['environment'],'preparation_sha256':sha(prep),'parents':p['parents'],
       'library_sha256':sha(ROOT/'build/bin/garnet.dll'),'cleanup_finished':False,'performance_admitted':False,'scope':p['scope']}
    def save():(out/'workflow.json').write_bytes(json.dumps(w,indent=2).encode())
    save();common=[prep,receipt]+[ROOT/n for n in p['new_files']]+[ROOT/'results'/(name+'-verified.json') for name in p['parents']]
    try:
        code=run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest',*p['test_ids']],out/'cpu-ledger','correctness','30strict old/new B8 witness, MTP target-state/token/count/parent and paged input fault controls',common)
        if code:raise RuntimeError('CPU B8 MTP gate failed')
        command=[sys.executable,str(M/'monitor_native_probe.py'),'--study',str(ROOT),'--output',str(out/'resources'),'--','cmd.exe','/d','/c',str(M/'test_paged_batch8_mtp.bat'),str(out/'model'),str(cache)]
        code=run(command,out/'gpu-ledger','correctness','Actual existing MTP3/T4/128MiB session: nine B8 short/full3968+128 text/image/permutation/reset cases; retained29complete target states and58raw vectors/IDs; no HTTP/timing admission',common)
        if code:raise RuntimeError('Actual paged B8 MTP target-state/token gate failed')
        report=json.loads((out/'model/report.json').read_bytes());assert report['retained_baseline_replay']['status']=='paged_batch8_mtp_retained_ordinary_exact'
        w['status']='paged_batch8_mtp_collected_needs_replay'
    except BaseException as error:w.update(status='failed',error=repr(error));code=code or 1
    finally:
        w.update(exit_code=code,source_after_sha256={n:sha(ROOT/n) for n in p['files']},runtime_dependencies_after={n:sha(ROOT/'build/bin'/n) for n in p['runtime']},
                 environment_after={n:sha(Path(n)) for n in p['environment']},library_unchanged=sha(ROOT/'build/bin/garnet.dll')==w['library_sha256']);save()
        idle();w['retired_private_engine_files']=retire(cache,ROOT,before,started);w['cleanup_finished']=True;save()
        paths=[f for f in out.rglob('*') if f.is_file()]+common;names={f.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix():f for f in paths}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            for n,f in names.items():z.write(f,n)
            z.writestr('evidence-manifest.json',json.dumps({'files':{n:sha(f) for n,f in names.items()},'linked_parent_archives':{n:v['archive_sha256'] for n,v in p['parents'].items()},'scope':p['scope']},indent=2))
        print(json.dumps({'status':w['status'],'archive_sha256':sha(archive),'bytes':archive.stat().st_size,'files':len(names)}),flush=True)
    return code
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

"""Replay every B8 MTP target state/vector/ID against actual closed ordinary bytes."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import sys
import zipfile
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]))
from test2026.cuda.qwen38_5090.paged_batch8_mtp import PARENT, BASELINE, replay_mtp, validate_parent

JOB = 'paged-batch8-mtp-admission-attempt1'
METHODS = 'Garnet/test2026/cuda/qwen38_5090/'
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def checked_archive(path):
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    manifest = json.loads(z.read('evidence-manifest.json'))
    assert z.testzip() is None and len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())) == len(manifest['files']) + 1
    for name, digest in manifest['files'].items():
        assert sha(z.read(name)) == digest
    return z, manifest


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--proofs', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    archive = args.proofs / (JOB + '-evidence.zip')
    z, manifest = checked_archive(archive)
    old, _ = checked_archive(args.proofs / (PARENT + '-evidence.zip'))
    with z, old:
        doc = lambda name: json.loads(z.read(name))
        prefix = 'results/' + JOB + '/'
        raw = z.read(METHODS + 'evidence/paged-batch8-mtp-preparation.json')
        p = json.loads(raw)
        w = doc(prefix + 'workflow.json')
        assert sha(raw) == w['preparation_sha256'] and p['status'] == 'paged_batch8_mtp_prepared_gpu_unrun'
        assert w['source_sha256'] == w['source_after_sha256'] == p['files']
        assert w['runtime_dependencies'] == w['runtime_dependencies_after'] == p['runtime']
        assert w['environment_before'] == w['environment_after'] == p['environment']
        assert w['library_sha256'] == p['runtime']['garnet.dll'] == BASELINE
        assert w['cleanup_finished'] is w['library_unchanged'] is True and type(w['exit_code']) is int
        assert w['parents'] == p['parents'] and set(p['parents']) == {PARENT}
        for name, digest in p['new_files'].items():
            assert sha(z.read(name)) == digest
        for name in ('verify_paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'paged_batch8_model.py',
                     'verify_bf16_batch8_admission.py', 'bf16_batch8_admission.py', 'bf16_packed_state_gate.py'):
            assert sha(Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_bytes()) == p['files'][METHODS + name]
        parent_raw = z.read('results/' + PARENT + '-verified.json')
        assert parent_raw == (args.proofs / (PARENT + '-verified.json')).read_bytes()
        q = json.loads(parent_raw)
        row = p['parents'][PARENT]
        parent_digest = sha((args.proofs / (PARENT + '-evidence.zip')).read_bytes())
        assert sha(parent_raw) == row['proof_sha256'] and q['status'] == row['status']
        assert parent_digest == row['archive_sha256'] == manifest['linked_parent_archives'][PARENT]
        closed = json.loads(old.read('results/' + PARENT + '/workflow.json'))
        validate_parent(q, closed, BASELINE, parent_digest)
        assert closed['runtime_dependencies_after'] == p['runtime'] and closed['environment_after'] == p['environment']
        assert p['files'] == {**closed['source_after_sha256'], **p['new_files']}
        passed = w['exit_code'] == 0
        replayed = memory = None
        if passed:
            assert w['status'] == 'paged_batch8_mtp_collected_needs_replay'
            for ledger in ('cpu-ledger', 'gpu-ledger'):
                rows = [json.loads(line) for line in z.read(prefix + ledger + '/commands.jsonl').splitlines()]
                assert len(rows) == 2 and rows[-1]['event'] == 'finished' and type(rows[-1]['exit_code']) is int and rows[-1]['exit_code'] == 0
            log = z.read(prefix + 'cpu-ledger/commands.log')
            assert ('Ran ' + str(p['expected_cpu_test_count']) + ' tests').encode() in log and b'\nOK' in log
            report = doc(prefix + 'model/report.json')
            reference = json.loads(old.read('results/' + PARENT + '/model/report.json'))
            assert report['ordinary_parent'] == {'job': PARENT, 'archive_sha256': parent_digest,
                'proof_sha256': sha(parent_raw), 'ordinary_model_preserved': True, 'mtp_or_http_or_performance_admitted': False}
            replayed = replay_mtp(report, lambda name: z.read(prefix + 'model/' + name), reference,
                                  lambda name: old.read('results/' + PARENT + '/model/' + name))
            assert replayed == report['retained_baseline_replay']
            resource = doc(prefix + 'resources/resource-monitor.json')
            samples = [json.loads(line) for line in z.read(prefix + 'resources/resource-vram.jsonl').splitlines()]
            assert type(resource['child_exit_code']) is int and resource['child_exit_code'] == 0 and resource['gpu']['uuid'] == p['gpu_uuid']
            assert samples and all(s['phase'] == 'construction-and-correctness' for s in samples)
            gaps = [b['monotonic'] - a['monotonic'] for a, b in zip(samples, samples[1:])]
            assert all(g > 0 for g in gaps)
            memory = resource['sampled_memory']
            assert memory['samples'] == len(samples) and memory['sampled_peak_adapter_used_bytes'] == max(s['used_bytes'] for s in samples)
            assert memory['observed_sample_gap_median_seconds'] == (statistics.median(gaps) if gaps else None)
            assert memory['observed_sample_gap_max_seconds'] == (max(gaps) if gaps else None)
        result = {'status': 'paged_batch8_mtp_target_state_replayed' if passed else 'paged_batch8_mtp_failure_preserved',
                  'archive_sha256': sha(archive.read_bytes()), 'files_verified': len(manifest['files']),
                  'library_sha256': BASELINE, 'ordinary_parent': row, 'mtp_target_state_replay': replayed,
                  'construction_correctness_adapter_sampled_memory': memory, 'external_b1_b4_math_qualified': False,
                  'broad_quality_qualified': False, 'http_qualified': False, 'serving_memory_saving_qualified': False,
                  'performance_admitted': False, 'two_times_target_achieved': False, 'scope': p['scope']}
    target = args.proofs / (JOB + '-verified.json')
    raw = json.dumps(result, indent=2).encode()
    assert not target.exists() or target.read_bytes() == raw
    if not target.exists():
        target.write_bytes(raw)
    print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'archive_sha256': result['archive_sha256'],
                      'files_verified': result['files_verified'], 'proof_sha256': sha(raw), 'target_states': 29 if passed else None}))
    return 0 if passed else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Require actual two-machine B8 preservation proof before pinning an MTP trial."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import unittest
import zipfile

METHODS = ('paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'test_paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'probe_paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'test_paged_batch8_mtp.bat',
           'run_paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'verify_paged_batch8_mtp.py', 'prepare_paged_batch8_mtp.py',
           'evidence/paged-batch8-mtp-probe-derivation.json', 'evidence/paged-batch8-mtp-owner-derivation.json')
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--proofs', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.proofs = args.proofs.resolve(strict=True)
    args.work = args.work.resolve(strict=True)
    methods = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    repo = methods.parents[2]
    sys.path[:0] = [str(repo), str(methods)]
    from test2026.cuda.qwen38_5090.paged_batch8_mtp import PARENT, BASELINE, validate_parent
    from test2026.cuda.qwen38_5090.run_logged import run
    path = args.proofs / (PARENT + '-verified.json')
    proof = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    assert proof == json.loads((args.proofs / (PARENT + '-remote-verified.json')).read_bytes())
    archive = args.proofs / (PARENT + '-evidence.zip')
    digest = sha(archive.read_bytes())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        manifest = json.loads(z.read('evidence-manifest.json'))
        assert z.testzip() is None and len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())) == len(manifest['files']) + 1
        for name, expected in manifest['files'].items():
            assert sha(z.read(name)) == expected
        w = json.loads(z.read('results/' + PARENT + '/workflow.json'))
    validate_parent(proof, w, BASELINE, digest)
    files = dict(w['source_after_sha256'])
    new = {'Garnet/test2026/cuda/qwen38_5090/' + name: sha((methods / name).read_bytes()) for name in METHODS}
    assert not set(new) & set(files)
    files.update(new)
    candidate = json.loads((methods / 'evidence/bf16-scores-tiled-native-api-build-preparation.json').read_bytes())['candidate_files']
    for name, expected in files.items():
        if name.startswith('Garnet/'):
            relative = name.removeprefix('Garnet/')
            assert sha((repo / relative).read_bytes()) == candidate.get(relative, expected), ('Baseline/candidate source drift', name)
    for name in METHODS:
        if name.endswith('.py'):
            ast.parse((methods / name).read_bytes())
    modules = ['test2026.cuda.qwen38_5090.' + name for name in ('test_bf16_batch8_admission', 'test_bf16_batch8_replay',
               'test_paged_batch8_model', 'test_paged_prompt_rows', 'test_paged_prompt_component', 'test_paged_batch8_mtp')]
    assert all('Garnet/' + name.replace('.', '/') + '.py' in files for name in modules)
    def ids(suite):
        for test in suite:
            if isinstance(test, unittest.TestSuite): yield from ids(test)
            else: yield test.id()
    loader = unittest.TestLoader()
    tests = sorted(ids(loader.loadTestsFromNames(modules)))
    assert not loader.errors and len(tests) == len(set(tests)) == 30
    os.chdir(repo)
    code = run([sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', *tests], args.work / 'paged-batch8-mtp-cpu-ledger', 'correctness',
               '30existing B8 ordinary/state/paged native controls and new independent MTP target-state/token/count/closed-parent faults',
               [methods / name for name in METHODS])
    assert code == 0
    p = {'status': 'paged_batch8_mtp_prepared_gpu_unrun', 'files': files, 'new_files': new,
         'runtime': w['runtime_dependencies_after'], 'environment': w['environment_after'],
         'parents': {PARENT: {'status': proof['status'], 'proof_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes()), 'archive_sha256': digest}},
         'test_ids': tests, 'expected_cpu_test_count': len(tests), 'gpu_uuid': 'GPU-265ee66c-9b79-cd3b-0c63-dd6942ddb5e6',
         'scope': 'Existing baseline1a1d B8 BF16-cache/T32prefill/T4decode mixedNVFP4/FP8 target plus existing MTP3/T4/128MiB prefix-replay session. No guard/default/kernel changes. Actual closed two-machine paged B8 ordinary proof required. All nine short/full3968+128text/image/original/rotated/reset cases must exactly preserve29complete target-state witnesses/58raw vectors/all output IDs against actual ordinary bytes. Empty stop list preserves fixed-count oracle semantics; not natural-stop quality admission. Paged128two-page input, actual model/MTP/vision construction and memory must fit; retain failure otherwise. Construction/correctness adapter-wide sampled peaks/gaps are not serving memory savings or timings. Existing source/runtime/SDK unchanged, actual ledgers/cache retirement/independent replay mandatory. External B1/B4 math,805quality,HTTP/throughput, strongest vLLM/SGLang references, repetitions and overall2x remain open.'}
    target = methods / 'evidence/paged-batch8-mtp-preparation.json'
    raw = json.dumps(p, indent=2).encode()
    assert not target.exists() or target.read_bytes() == raw
    if not target.exists(): target.write_bytes(raw)
    rows = [{'local': str(methods / name), 'target': 'Garnet/test2026/cuda/qwen38_5090/' + name,
             'sha256': sha((methods / name).read_bytes())} for name in METHODS]
    rows.append({'local': str(target), 'target': 'Garnet/test2026/cuda/qwen38_5090/evidence/' + target.name, 'sha256': sha(raw)})
    (args.work / 'paged-batch8-mtp-upload-plan.json').write_bytes(json.dumps({'uploads': rows}, indent=2).encode())
    print(json.dumps({'status': p['status'], 'source_pins': len(files), 'cpu_tests': 30, 'new_targets': len(rows), 'preparation_sha256': sha(raw)}))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
